research_question: Does the validation-selected FrameContact checkpoint depend causally on intra-chain geometry while remaining invariant to independent rigid transforms of the two unaligned monomers?
claim_boundary: Post-selection diagnostic on authenticated antigen-fold validation only. It cannot select a checkpoint, fit calibration, change an intervention after seeing its result, or open frozen/external test data.
checkpoint_rule: Use exactly the checkpoint selected by the parent development run and its frozen validation temperatures and thresholds.

interventions.name: independent_monomer_rigid_transform
interventions.definition: Apply independent random proper rotations and translations to antibody and antigen N/CA/C coordinates.
interventions.expected_direction: Predictions and ranking metrics remain numerically unchanged.

interventions.name: geometry_shuffle
interventions.definition: Permute residue frames within each monomer while preserving sequence, residue identity, masks, and targets.

interventions.name: local_frame_corruption
interventions.definition: Independently rotate N and C offsets around each fixed CA, preserving sequence and CA positions.
interventions.expected_direction: Direction/pose-dependent metrics worsen more than distance-only information.

interventions.name: degree_matched_graph_rewiring
interventions.definition: Replace each intra-chain spatial-neighbor graph with a same-chain degree-matched null graph.

interventions.name: coordinate_noise
interventions.definition: Add Gaussian noise to observed N/CA/C coordinates while preserving sequence and targets.
interventions.expected_direction: Metric degradation is nondecreasing in aggregate with noise scale; individual seeds may be nonmonotonic.

clean_and_intervened_metrics: contact precision and recall at the validation-frozen threshold
both directional cluster-weighted partner margins, top-1, and MRR
reporting.failures: Report every failure, non-finite output, and missing seed.
